verdictScope: Design review of the proposed Design choice-feedback fix and verification plan; not implementation or native acceptance.

assessment.witnessedDefect: Design choice feedback controls and selection mode are omitted from its shared response-builder call. A saved correct selection therefore renders as plain selected, not selected-correct; multi-choice can inherit radio semantics.
assessment.canonicalReuse: projectCanonicalChoiceFeedbackControls already provides frozen per-option states by stable ID and validates matching response/interaction type.
assessment.boundary: The facade exposes feedback only for materialized attempts; committed-only response state must not produce correctness controls.
assessment.scope: Adapter and presentation tests plus one native refresh/resume of the saved Q2; no score, response, persistence, content, auth, provider, or schema changes.

conditions: Derive feedback controls only from an existing materialized attempt, never from the committed-only response fallback; retain absence of feedback before materialization and through journal failure.
Derive selection mode from canonical interaction type: choice_multiple is multiple, choice_single is single. Do not infer mode from response array length.
Keep controls keyed by stable option ID and preserve session option order; non-choice controls remain absent/empty and ordering/matrix rendering is unaffected.

Extend designInterviewChoiceFeedback durable-submit/rebind and committed-only/recovery assertions with selected-correct, selected-incorrect, and omitted-correct states; add a representative multi-choice projection case.

Extend the actual screen adapter regression seam using the TypeScript AST expression extraction pattern in practiceFeedbackDelivery.test.ts, evaluating the real buildPracticeResponseControl input with feedback controls and interaction-derived mode.

Native acceptance refreshes the same saved Q2 and verifies unchanged session/index/selected option/attempt count plus the Selected, correct accessibility semantics. Never resubmit Q2; then continue the already-authorized wrong-response/Details flow.

sourceEvidence.fact: Projection feedback is based on materializedAttempt, while response may fall back to a committed attempt.
Canonical helper returns stable-ID feedback states for choice single/multiple and validates response type.
Current builder call receives only local response and renderer; feedback is forwarded separately to PracticeSessionSurface.
Shared builder consumes feedback keyed by stable ID and defaults choice selection mode to single.
Selection mode selects radio or checkbox semantics; option state drives accessibility correctness values.
Existing tests cover real Design pools, durable submit, rebind, journal failure, committed-only hiding, and recovery, but currently assert messages rather than controls.
Existing AST-based test evaluates actual Design JSX adapter expressions and can cover this screen wiring regression seam.

limitations: No source implementation or tests were modified or run by this review.
Native saved-Q2 semantics and state preservation remain to be observed after implementation.

A native multi-choice assertion is optional if it requires creating or replacing a session; the representative canonical projection plus actual-adapter contract test is adequate for this wiring slice.
This slice does not establish full BIZQ-01, provider, or release acceptance.
